Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4513221. Join activities to assays on assay_id, filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513221', and require standard_value IS NOT NULL and standard_relation = '='. Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno and join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN on molregno to enforce structure presence. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
